boundedAnswers.answer: A source, locator, rights, scope, boundary, dependency, implementation, or release change requires a new exact-revision review.

publicationBoundary: Content implementation is complete locally. Owner routing, exact canonical release, sitemap inclusion, build authorization, served-output inspection, and deployment remain separate gates.
